goals._track_note: Track A — Trust Foundation (G1-G5). Structural correctness of the DDD primitive/module/service layers.
goals.title: Primitives ship with scenarios
goals.calibration: 3-5 Go primitives in apps/alert-engine/pkg/primitive/ (candidates: signal-classifier, dedup-key-builder, cooldown-gate, duplicate-checker, alert-formatter — dev-alert-engine confirms exact set Phase 0). Each ≥3 scenarios (golden + edge + failure). Verify: CGO_ENABLED=0 go run ./cmd/sandbox -tier=primitive -scenario=all exits 0; ≥1 failure scenario; grep mattn/go-sqlite3 in pkg/primitive = 0; grep -iE 'token|chat_id|bot|secret|api_key' in pkg/primitive = 0 (ZERO-CREDS gate). Min 9 scenario files (3 prim × 3).

goals.title: Module composes primitives via ports
goals.calibration: ONE module: apps/alert-engine/pkg/module/alert_pipeline/. Composes primitives via interface + injected AlertRepositoryPort + MutePort + TelegramPort (infra impls, never imported directly). Multi-primitive scenario = alert pipeline story (classify → fingerprint → dedup → cooldown → format → route). Fence-B + ZERO-CREDS + CGO: grep pkg/module/ imports (cross-module=0) + grep mattn/go-sqlite3|pkg/infrastructure in module = 0 + grep -iE 'telegram|bot_token|chat_id' in module = 0. mute_gate module deferred post-pilot.

goals.title: Microservice has clean composition root
goals.calibration: cmd/server/main.go wires module + adapters; CGO SQLite repo + TelegramClient injected HERE as infra impls of AlertRepositoryPort/MutePort/TelegramPort. Zero domain logic in root. OpenAPI YAML in pkg/interface/http/. Port = 5006 internal AND external (system-map.json, never hardcoded). grep ComputeFingerprint|IsDuplicate|ShouldSuppressAlert|joinSignalTypes in main.go = 0.

goals.title: Architecture fence enforced (offline depguard evidence)
goals.calibration: Go service → depguard via golangci-lint (SAME mechanism as TA+macro+stock-price, NO SI-3/TS-fence dependency). apps/alert-engine/.golangci.yml: Fence-A (pkg/primitive must not import application/infrastructure/interface OR mattn/go-sqlite3 OR Telegram client), Fence-B (pkg/module must not import infrastructure OR mattn/go-sqlite3), Fence-C (infra importable ONLY from cmd/server/main.go; exclusions !cmd/server/main.go, !*_test.go). CI job alert-engine-go-lint working-directory=apps/alert-engine OR offline proof. Pre-revert tag alert-engine-pre-ci. AC-4a CI job, AC-4b deliberate Fence-A violation reproduces non-zero exit with 'Fence-A' + reverted + never committed (QA independent), AC-4c .golangci.yml freeze anchor most-recent commit on file at close.

goals.title: Edit-JSON-and-rerun works (ZERO credentials, ZERO CGO in sandbox)
goals.calibration: HEADLINE RISK. User edits scenario JSON, refreshes dashboard, sees updated result. ALL 4 sub-gates must PASS: (1) env audit: env | grep -iE 'TELEGRAM|BOT_TOKEN|CHAT_ID|TOKEN|SECRET|API_KEY|PASSWORD' returns empty; (2) scenario JSON grep -rniE 'token|chat_id|bot|secret|api_key|password' apps/alert-engine/cmd/sandbox/ = 0; (3) sandbox compiles under CGO_ENABLED=0; (4) edit→rerun→updated-trace cycle works end-to-end. All 4 required — missing any one = G7 NOT PASS.

goals.title: Red/green status is honest (honest-red contract)
goals.calibration: Two tests proven before G8 grades YES: Test A (deliberately corrupted scenario e.g. flip expected suppress:false → suppress:true in cooldown-gate golden) → dashboard RED, diff captured; Test B (known-good golden after revert) → dashboard GREEN, diff=null. No false green tolerated.

goals.title: Dashboard is the trust contract — short-circuit via PO Playwright (Day-0 default, L6)

Acceptance: ZERO console errors, ZERO pageerrors, ZERO requestfailed, all 3 panels rendered, NOT-RUN status honest. Either path equal weight.
